cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've left your car at the garage. I'll handle the collection; first I'll get us a good breakfast in their cafe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did my car need the garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll get the best value while we're here. You choose the breakfast; I'll order exactly what you fancy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask the mechanic about the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wait to order until you've compared the menus with me. You know which deal is worth having; I won't choose without your verdict. Start with the cooked breakfast or the pastries?
